briefing.text: On the news platform, Information Technology stays #1 (buzz 81.2, down 3.8 on the day, down 1.2 on the week, mentions down 69%, sentiment -0.03), led by NVDA, MSFT, AMD, AVGO and AAPL. Materials fell hardest (buzz 67.7, down 9.8; mentions down 74%; CBT, FCX, NEM) and Financials dropped 9.7 to 68.6 (BAC, UBS, MS). On X, IT is #1 at 92.6 (down 0.4, sentiment 0.09; NVDA, MU, AMD) while Financial Services buzz fell 17.6 to 27.6 (mentions down 80%, PAXG only) and Utilities rose 2.4 (sentiment 0.28; VST, CEG). On Reddit, IT leads at 94.1 (down 1.0, sentiment -0.04) and Financials climbed from #5 to #2 (buzz 91.1, up 0.5, up 2.4 on the week; MS, GS, SOFI), while Healthcare buzz fell 35.1 on 82% fewer mentions (MEDS).

BJ #1: no news in the file; the rank rests on volume (1.37 vs normal) and a 3.6-sigma price move, not headlines.
ADI #2: Benzinga lists it among stocks priced for big swings ahead of earnings on 11-24; supports the rank via the catalyst.
SKHY #3: fund-purchase roundups on Yahoo Finance (25 articles in 2 days, 9 positive, 5 negative); stock is down 13% in 24h, so the move, not the news, drives the rank.
DKS #5: Yahoo comparison piece vs Coupang; earnings 11-24 (1 positive, 4 negative articles) is the likelier reason for the rank.
ZS #6: reports that CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler (18 articles, 9 positive); this explains the strong attention readings.
KR #7: story on Kroger offshoring jobs to India (6 articles, 3 negative); minor, earnings on 12-03 matter more.
NVDA #8: 440 articles, 42 positive and 83 negative, on AI-trade bust worries; fits the 4.6-sigma move and 14% drop.
MSTR #10: oversold-bounce and miner-roundup pieces (7 articles, 5 negative); matches the 9.7% drop.
BBY #12: Black Friday and market-bottom pieces (8 articles); earnings 11-24 is the likelier driver.
SOFI #13: pieces on a possible 10% card-rate cap and SoFiUSD expansion (5 articles, 1 negative); little effect on rank.

BJ (#1, score 0.916) ranks on abnormal volume (1.37 above normal, top percentile) and a 3.6-sigma price move; its attention reading is slightly below normal but still in the 84th to 93rd percentile. ADI (#2, 0.883) combines X attention 0.11 above normal, a 2.1-sigma, 8.3% drop and earnings on 11-24 with a Polymarket beat market priced at 0.88. SKHY (#3, 0.882) has the highest X mentions of the three (135) and a 2.1-sigma, 13% fall, though its volume is only 0.53 above normal. None of the three has attention far above normal, so momentum and volume carry them.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
